corrections.reason: No period-specific endorsement of equal same-sex adoption was established. Conventional household hierarchy makes qualified disagreement more plausible; personal behaviour or reforms on other social issues do not establish this distinct position.

Read the complete condition: parliament can reject and terminate the temporary law. Absolute royal command provides no equivalent parliamentary veto; agreement merely with emergency action would omit this constraint.
A voter recall of an elected representative has no supported place in the documented royal settlement; local consultation is not a binding popular removal right.
The army was subordinated to the sovereign. Command of soldiers does not establish support for an army replacing the legitimate ruler on its own judgement.
